name: Coded Singletons
definition: For n at least 1, take primary coordinates p_1,...,p_n and r=ceil(log_2(n+1)) tag coordinates. Assign distinct r-bit strings c_0,c_1,...,c_n to the n+1 indices. The class has n+1 concepts h_0,...,h_n: h_i is positive precisely on p_i when i is nonzero and has tag labels c_i.
